THE_COMMITTED_COST_BASIS_WAS_WRONG.what_the_plan_said: 0.54 credits per attempt, and 'a refusal costs the same as a good page, so this figure is the ceiling regardless of yield'
THE_COMMITTED_COST_BASIS_WAS_WRONG.what_was_measured_here: a SUCCESSFUL scrape costs exactly 1 credit; a call the origin refuses on every Firecrawl engine costs 0 credits and returns HTTP 500 SCRAPE_ALL_ENGINES_FAILED
THE_COMMITTED_COST_BASIS_WAS_WRONG.how_it_was_measured: one probe per distinct host before committing the run. Two probes (Hilton, Marriott) were refused and the balance did not move: 513 before, 513 after. Four probes that returned a document moved it by exactly 4.
THE_COMMITTED_COST_BASIS_WAS_WRONG.why_the_0.54_average_was_misleading: it was an average over 203 historical attempts that silently mixed free refusals with billed successes. Averaging a bimodal 0-or-1 cost produced a number that describes no single call.
THE_COMMITTED_COST_BASIS_WAS_WRONG.consequence_for_this_run: the plan predicted 36 rows would cost 19.44 credits. They cost 17, because 22 of the 36 were refused for free. Had every row served, 36 rows would have cost 36 credits and the cap would have stopped the run at 18 -- so the cap was enforced on ATTEMPTS with a live balance re-read every fifth call, never on the plan's arithmetic.
THE_COMMITTED_COST_BASIS_WAS_WRONG.correction_owed: a later order should restate the unit cost in the cross-run ledger doctrine as bimodal (1 credit on success, 0 on engine refusal) rather than as a blended average

refuses_every_engine_at_zero_cost.note: counts are of cohort rows that came back SCRAPE_ALL_ENGINES_FAILED; two Choice rows and one Radisson row DID serve, so the wall is per-URL and not strictly per-host

the_firecrawl_wall_for_this_market.operational_value: a refusal is free, so the wall can be mapped for nothing before any spend is committed. That probe-first step is what kept this run to 17 credits.

identity_gate.rule: publication grade requires the property's own page to state the census street address AND postal code, plus the census telephone whenever the census carries one; a brand property code in the URL substitutes for a telephone the census lacks
identity_gate.street_matching_is_normalised: Drive/Dr, Avenue/Ave, Circle/Cir and the directionals are folded before comparison. Without that fold, 'extended stay america indianapolis plainfield' would have been wrongly rejected on '6295 Gateway Drive' against the page's '6295 Gateway Dr'.
identity_gate.a_substring_match_is_not_a_binding: the 'comfort suites' row appeared to match street, number and postal by substring on a 5.4 MB Choice brand INDEX listing many properties. The telephone check refused it, and the page's own postal codes (46124, 46131, 46140) are none of them the census 46237. Binding must be against the page's declared address fields, never against the presence of a string somewhere in a large document.
